decisions.reason: Report locates the throwing disabled expression in AttachmentChips (cited in plugin-dock-chips.js), shows busy is state declared in the sibling AttachButton and neither in scope nor passed as a prop, explains the empty-dock early return skips the map, and that a plain-phase left operand makes || evaluate busy and throw ReferenceError.

Explains the render exception is caught by the InputZone slot error boundary, which unmounts the entire dock entry rather than just the remove button, that the attach button is a separate surviving slot entry, and that the diagnostic appears only in the browser console with no user-facing banner.

Uses the shipped v0.2.10 line (corroborated by the maintainer note) to establish busy predates the diff, proposes rollback/re-add bisection and a minimal data-present plain-phase mount as isolation, explicitly avoids exonerating the diff by flagging its own out-of-scope status/record reads, misplaced imageItem, repeated busy reference, and does not overclaim about historical users beyond the maintainer's note.

Proposes deleting the dangling busy reference while keeping the phase guard, offering properly owned state via props/input as the alternative; hardens record?.items with ?? [] and event.target with closest?.(); and moves the diff's imageItem computation inside the map callback where record/status are defined.

Proposes a jsdom mount with at least one matching occurrence in plain phase, asserting the chip DOM renders and no error boundary captured anything; explains the empty state returns null before the throwing line and that node --check is a parse check that cannot catch free identifiers or execute the component; requires the data-present slot smoke as a release CI gate.
